title: Static lower-hull support queries
input: n q; n point rows x y; q direction rows a b
output: strict lower chain length and coordinates, then EMPTY or exact maximum a*x+b*y and lexicographically smallest maximizing coordinates for every query
construction_oracle: Exact full-set scan, lexicographically smallest coordinate on ties
complexity: O(n^2) construction with O(n) storage/recursion; O(q log(max(2,n))) queries
